title_as_printed: Water Content of a CO2-CH4 Mixture Containing 5.31 mol % CH4 in CO2 in Equilibrium with a H2O(l)-Rich Phase along the Three-Phase Locus

footnotes_as_printed.b: Initial hydrate formation and quadruple point, estimated.

pressure_note: printed as 'pressure, psia/MPa'; system pressure measured by a transducer; the paper does not say whether it is total or partial, it is the cell pressure of the three-phase locus (total)
gas_basis_evidence: pure water (no salt); water mole fraction is of the sampled CO2-CH4-rich phase, water included

composition.other_species: Gas phase is a certified CO2-CH4 mixture containing 5.31 mol % CH4; the water-rich liquid is pure water (triply distilled)

row_regime_overrides.reason: phase sampled is the CO2-rich liquid (L2) of the three-phase locus, not the vapor
estimated initial hydrate formation and quadruple point; no experimental value

conversion_needs: temp C and pressure psia columns are redundant with temp F / MPa
notes: Each row gives the water content of one sampled phase (vapor or liquid) of the CO2-CH4 mixture in equilibrium with a water-rich liquid. Row 1 temperature printed 60/15.66 although 60 F = 15.56 C (same T as row 0); kept as printed, likely misprint. Row 6 (83.1 F, 28.39 C) and row 7 (53.0 F, 11.67 C) have no water content; row 7 is an estimated point. The column printed 'phase sampled' of rows 6-7 reads '3-phase critical end point' over two lines; written once on row 6.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: row 1 prints temperature 60 F / 15.66 C, but 60 F = 15.56 C (same isotherm as row 0; Table III lists both at 15.6 C / 60 F); the F column is internally consistent for all rows, so T is read from the temp F column.
